name: Grand Teton crest patch (Buck Mountain -> Mount Moran)
projection: equirectangular (regular lat/lon grid); row 0 = latMax, col 0 = lonMin
license: public domain / open data (Mapzen Terrain Tiles, USGS 3DEP + SRTM)
encoding: RGB8 PNG; value = (R << 8) | G; B unused. elev_m = minElev + value / 65535 * (maxElev - minElev)
